preconditions.description: Number of cities is between 2 and 1000.
Number of flights is between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai < bi <= n for ai, bi in flights)
preconditions.description: Each flight is from a smaller city number to a larger city number.
Number of flights matches the given count.

postconditions.description: The first line of output is either 'Yes' or 'No'.
If the output is 'Yes', there are m+1 lines in total.
If the output is 'No', there is only one line.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'Yes' and all(duration in [1, 2] for duration in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', all flight durations are either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'Yes' and all(sum(durations[i] for i in range(len(flights))) == sum(durations[j] for j in range(len(flights))) for durations in valid_durations)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', all paths from city 1 to city n have the same total duration.
